exposure: Modified Bell's stage 2 or more for necrotizing enterocolitis classification
cohort: Newborns with congenital heart disease (CHD) who underwent cardiac surgery during the neonatal period (≤ 28 days of age) between 2007 and 2017
finding: Caesarean delivery was strongly associated with the development of necrotizing enterocolitis in newborns with critical CHD.
mod_finding: Birth by caesarean delivery (compared to vaginal) was strongly associated with development of necrotising enterocolitis.
